title: plugin-gantt: a gantt-only row ceiling set by measurement (target 10,000) instead of the shared 2,000 non-grid ceiling
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwxNJ1s5i1doop7KEv
Ruled: 6842306915 · letter B · 2026-11-13T02:47Z

> **Ruled (letter B, comment 6842306915):** the gantt gets no author knob; `pagination.pageSize` / `limit` stay unread. It leaves the shared 2,000 ceiling for a gantt-only measured ceiling (target 10,000), not read from `external.rowCap`. The request below is the filed text, superseded where it differs.

## Scope

Change `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` only. `NON_GRID_ROW_CEILING` (2000) itself, and tree / calendar / map / kanban behaviour, stay exactly as they are.

## Request

- When a gantt view **explicitly declares** `pagination.pageSize`, fetch with `$top = pageSize + 1` and cap at `pageSize` (same probe-row mechanism as `nonGridRowCeilingQuery` / `applyNonGridRowCeiling`, parameterised).
- When it does not declare one, keep today's 2000 ceiling and `NonGridRowCeilingNote`. The schema default of 50 must **not** apply to gantt.
- If the declared `pageSize` exceeds the datasource `external.rowCap`, the effective ceiling is `rowCap` (or a clear notice).

## Why gantt can be the exception (all from the platform's own source, main 7d82b2da)

1. `ui/packages/core/src/utils/non-grid-row-ceiling.ts` measures gantt as **virtualised**: 726 DOM elements at 2,000 rows (484ms) and still 726 at 4,000 rows (420ms). The 2,000 ceiling is set by `ObjectTree`, which is not virtualised (10,406 DOM elements / 2,720ms at 2,000 rows). Gantt pays the tree's limit without the tree's cost.
2. `PaginationConfigSchema.pageSize` (spec `ui/view.zod.ts`) already says: *"On a view with no pager (kanban, gallery, timeline) it is the fetch ceiling, and the renderer owes two things: bound its fetch at this number, and … show a visible truncation signal"*. `plugin-kanban` honours it; `plugin-gantt` does not read it (`ObjectGantt.tsx` ~L1058–1064: "Not authorable").
3. objectui#7210 / ruling a′ rejected `pageSize` because of (a) **silent** truncation and (b) capping a complete schedule at one (default) page. Both are avoided here: truncation stays visible via the existing note, and only an **explicitly declared** value applies — the default 50 never does.

## Our case

Following #27130 we moved our production-scheduling gantt to a plugin driver + virtual object (`provider: 'object'`) and, per #29762, declared `external.rowCap: 10000` on the datasource (18.3.0). The server now returns the full set, but the console gantt still fetches `$top: 2001` and draws the first 2,000 rows ("仅显示 4999 条记录中的前 2000 条"). Production data reached ~1,500 gantt rows in about six weeks and keeps growing; a date window or project filter cannot guarantee staying under 2,000, and planners cannot schedule on a truncated tree.

## Acceptance criteria

- A gantt view with `pagination: { pageSize: 10000 }` over a 10,000-row virtual object shows all rows, drag write-back works, no truncation note.
- A gantt view without `pageSize` behaves exactly as today.
- tree / calendar / map / kanban behave exactly as today.

## Related

objectui#7210 (ruling a′), #27130, #29762.
